title: Product Ad Templates for Photos and Videos | AIVideosUGC
description: Browse product ad templates for photos and short videos. Pick a style, add your product photo, and receive a new image or clip in the same look. Start today.
h1: Product Ad Templates You Can Use With One Photo
lead: Browse product ad templates by format, industry, or platform. Open any card to see the example and start from one product photo.
card: Ready-made looks for videos and photos. Pick one and add your product.
intro: Each template is a ready-made style for a product photo or short video, shown with an example so you know what to expect. Choose one that fits your product and where you'll post it, like a close-up detail shot for Amazon or a drink pour for TikTok. Upload a photo of your own product, add a line about the setting if you like, and you'll get a result with a similar look. Photos are square by default. Videos come in 9:16, 1:1, or 16:9 and last 6, 10, or 15 seconds.
Add a photo of your product to make a new image or video in a similar style. Photos are square by default; videos can be 9:16, 1:1, or 16:9 and last 6, 10, or 15 seconds.

faq.q: How do I choose a product ad template?
faq.a: Choose by the buyer moment you need: unboxing for a reveal, close-up for a detail, try-on for fit, demo for use, or a promotion template when you will add an offer after download.

faq.q: Can I adapt a template to my own product?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a sharp product photo and describe the action and setting you need. The template provides a starting composition; review every result for product drift.

faq.q: Which video lengths can I choose?
faq.a: Video jobs are available in 6, 10 or 15 seconds. Choose the length that gives one action enough time to read.
Photos are square by default. Crop a downloaded still for a specific placement such as a 4:5 Meta Feed image.

faq.q: Which template works for an Amazon listing?
faq.a: Start with a white-background or close-up photo template for the gallery, then check the current category rules before uploading the main image.

faq.q: Can I add a price, code, or headline in the template?
faq.a: Add exact prices, codes, headlines, and countdowns after download in your editor so the wording stays correct and easy to update.

faq.q: Will the generated result keep my product shape and color?
faq.a: Use a clear source photo with the full item visible, then compare the result with the source before publishing. AI output can still need a correction or another run.

faq.q: Can I use one template for both a photo and a video?
faq.a: Pick the template's photo or video version. Photos are square; videos can use 9:16, 1:1, or 16:9 and last 6, 10, or 15 seconds.

faq.q: Can templates link to the platform where I sell?
faq.a: Yes. Use the platform filters to find TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube Shorts, Amazon, or Shopify guidance, then open the linked page before you publish.

faq.q: Do I need editing experience to start?
faq.a: No. Upload one product photo, choose a template, and review the generated result. You can add final text or sound in your usual editor after download.
